notes: Primary source: official Kramer datasheet (cdn-docs.av-iq.com/dataSheet/VS-88UT_Datasheet.pdf) cross-verified against the official Kramer User Manual (P/N 2900-300582 Rev 3, cdn-docs.av-iq.com/other/VS-88UT_UserManual.pdf), both hosted mirrors of manufacturer content and internally consistent. This is an 8x8 all-in-one presentation matrix switcher with integrated HDBaseT 2.0 extension, master room controller, PoE, and a built-in power amplifier — it does not map to a single category cleanly; "switcher"/"Matrix router" was chosen since matrix switching is the core function, but it also serves as a control processor and amplifier. HDMI inputs 5-8 and outputs are physically shared/selectable with HDBaseT (RJ-45) pairs (HDMI IN 5/6/7/8 share connectors with HDBaseT IN 5/6/7/8 — only one type active at a time per pair, set in software); modeled here as separate logical ports per the datasheet's port table. HDMI is rated HDMI 2.0/HDCP 1.4 (grade hdmi-2.0) per "Standards Compliance" spec; HDBaseT ports carry the same 4K60 4:2:0 video plus USB/Ethernet/RS-232/IR tunneling (HDBaseT has no entry in the required SDI/HDMI/DP/USB/RJ45 grade scales, so left ungraded). The 1G Ethernet and Control Ethernet ports are 100BaseT/10/100 per manual wording ("100BaseT Ethernet") though marketing copy calls one "1G Ethernet" (likely referring to Gigabit-capable HDBaseT tunneling channel, not the RJ-45 NIC speed itself) — graded eth-100m conservatively per the explicit "100BaseT" spec label; not confirmed as true Gigabit Ethernet. USB Host/Device ports are HDBaseT-tunneled USB 1.1/2.0 at up to 127Mbps (well below usb-5g) so graded usb-2.0. Power input is a rear IEC power connector (with integrated switch and fuse) confirmed via rear-panel photo/diagram in the manual; input rated 100-240V AC 50/60Hz, 250VA. Two K-NET-related jacks exist: a 4-pin terminal block "K-NET" connector (power+RS-485 control bus, front controller side) and a "K-NET 5mm Mini-jack" learning port for IR — the mini-jack is IR-learning only and mapped to ir connector; the 4-pin K-NET terminal block carries 12V power + RS-485 and has no exact match in the connector list, so mapped to euroblock-dc (closest: DC-power-carrying terminal block) with a note. REMOTE MUTE and PROGRAM GPIO terminal blocks are internal/auxiliary contact-closure connectors for mute/future-use, not part of the core signal chain, and were omitted as they are not standard AV signal or power I/O in the requested sense — flagged in case they should be included. Combo/selectable audio input 5-pin terminal block accepts either balanced stereo line or balanced mic (modeled as accepts: euroblock since no dedicated "mic-euroblock" id exists).

ports.name: HDMI IN 5 / HDBT IN 5
ports.note: Shared/selectable port: HDMI female connector paired with an RJ-45 HDBaseT input; only one is active at a time (software-selectable, HDBaseT active by default).

ports.name: HDMI IN 6 / HDBT IN 6
ports.note: Shared/selectable port: HDMI female connector paired with an RJ-45 HDBaseT input; only one is active at a time (software-selectable, HDBaseT active by default).

ports.name: HDMI IN 7 / HDBT IN 7
ports.note: Shared/selectable port: HDMI female connector paired with an RJ-45 HDBaseT input; only one is active at a time (software-selectable, HDBaseT active by default).

ports.name: HDMI IN 8 / HDBT IN 8
ports.note: Shared/selectable port: HDMI female connector paired with an RJ-45 HDBaseT input; only one is active at a time (software-selectable, HDBaseT active by default).

ports.name: HDBT IN 5
ports.note: HDBaseT 2.0, shares selectable pairing with HDMI IN 5. 4K@60Hz(4:2:0) up to 100m; also tunnels USB, IR, RS-232, PoE.

ports.name: HDBT IN 6
ports.note: HDBaseT 2.0, shares selectable pairing with HDMI IN 6. 4K@60Hz(4:2:0) up to 100m; also tunnels USB, IR, RS-232, PoE.

ports.name: HDBT IN 7
ports.note: HDBaseT 2.0, shares selectable pairing with HDMI IN 7. 4K@60Hz(4:2:0) up to 100m; also tunnels USB, IR, RS-232, PoE.

ports.name: HDBT IN 8
ports.note: HDBaseT 2.0, shares selectable pairing with HDMI IN 8. 4K@60Hz(4:2:0) up to 100m; also tunnels USB, IR, RS-232, PoE.

ports.name: OUT 5 (HDBT)
ports.note: HDBaseT 2.0 output with PoE, up to 100m at 4K60(4:2:0); tunnels USB, IR, RS-232.

ports.name: OUT 6 (HDBT)
ports.note: HDBaseT 2.0 output with PoE, up to 100m at 4K60(4:2:0); tunnels USB, IR, RS-232.

ports.name: AUDIO INPUT (MIC/line) 1
ports.note: 5-pin terminal block, selectable per-input as balanced stereo line or 2x balanced mic.

ports.name: AUDIO INPUT (MIC/line) 2
ports.note: 5-pin terminal block, selectable per-input as balanced stereo line or 2x balanced mic.

ports.name: AUDIO INPUT (MIC/line) 3
ports.note: 5-pin terminal block, selectable per-input as balanced stereo line or 2x balanced mic.

ports.name: AUDIO INPUT (MIC/line) 4
ports.note: 5-pin terminal block, selectable per-input as balanced stereo line or 2x balanced mic.

ports.name: AUDIO INPUT 5
ports.note: Unbalanced stereo, 3.5mm mini jack.

ports.name: AUDIO INPUT 6
ports.note: Unbalanced stereo, 3.5mm mini jack.

ports.name: AUDIO INPUT 7
ports.note: Unbalanced stereo, 3.5mm mini jack.

ports.name: AUDIO INPUT 8
ports.note: Unbalanced stereo, 3.5mm mini jack.

ports.name: LINE OUT 1
ports.note: Balanced stereo audio output, 5-pin terminal block.

ports.name: LINE OUT 2
ports.note: Balanced stereo audio output, 5-pin terminal block.

ports.name: POWER AMP OUT
ports.note: Stereo speaker output, 4-pin terminal block, 2x50W into 4 ohms (or 2x30W into 4 ohms).

ports.name: IR IN 1/2
ports.note: 3.5mm mini jack, connects external IR receiver(s) for room-controller IR learning/input.

ports.name: IR OUT (room controller) 1-4
ports.note: IR emitter terminal block connectors (4x), for controlling IR devices.

ports.name: HDBT IR 5/6 IN
ports.note: 3.5mm mini jack pair for IR tunneling via HDBaseT inputs 5 and 6.

ports.name: HDBT IR 5/6 OUT
ports.note: 3.5mm mini jack pair for IR tunneling via HDBaseT outputs 5 and 6.

ports.name: RS-232 HDBT DATA
ports.note: 3-pin terminal block (G, Rx, Tx); passes serial data to/from HDBaseT ports (tunneling).

ports.name: RS-232 CONTROL
ports.note: 3-pin terminal block (G, Rx, Tx); controls the VS-88UT itself via Protocol 3000.

ports.name: RS-232 (room controller) 1-4
ports.note: 4x 3-pin terminal blocks for controlling third-party RS-232 devices from the master room controller.

ports.name: RS-485 (room controller)
ports.note: 3-pin terminal block; bidirectional RS-485 control bus, with a rear TERM switch for 120-ohm line termination.

ports.name: GPI/O 1-4 (room controller)
ports.note: 4x 2-pin terminal blocks, individually configurable as digital input, digital output, or analog input.

ports.name: RELAYS 1-8 (room controller)
ports.note: 8x 2-pin terminal blocks, dry contact closure (36V AC/DC, 2A, 60VAC max on non-inductive load).

ports.name: K-NET
ports.note: 4-pin terminal block carrying RS-485 control plus +12V power for auxiliary room controllers/keypads. No exact connector-list match; mapped to nearest DC-power-carrying terminal block type.

ports.name: HDBT USB Device 1
ports.note: Female USB-A, tunnels USB client data via HDBaseT (up to 127Mbps effective, USB1.1/2.0).

ports.name: HDBT USB Device 2
ports.note: Female USB-A, tunnels USB client data via HDBaseT (up to 127Mbps effective, USB1.1/2.0).

ports.name: HDBT USB Host 1
ports.note: Female USB-B host port, tunnels USB host data via HDBaseT.

ports.name: HDBT USB Host 2
ports.note: Female USB-B host port, tunnels USB host data via HDBaseT.

ports.name: ETH CONTROL
ports.note: RJ-45, 100BaseT, PC/network control of the unit.

ports.name: ETH DATA 1G
ports.note: RJ-45; datasheet markets it as "1G Ethernet" for tunneling data via HDBT ports, but the manual's own technical-spec table lists this Ethernet interface family as 100BaseT — graded conservatively as eth-100m since true Gigabit is not explicitly confirmed.

ports.name: AC Power
ports.note: Rear IEC power inlet with integrated power switch and fuse; 100-240V AC 50/60Hz, 250VA.
